quests.title: Five-minute stretch
quests.description: Stand up, reach for the ceiling, roll the shoulders. Five minutes, no form required.

quests.title: Kitchen dance
quests.description: One whole song, moving the entire time. Curtains optional.

quests.title: Stair drill
quests.description: Climb a flight of stairs five times. Lifts do not count; Pell is watching.

quests.title: Short patrol
quests.description: A fifteen-minute walk at any pace. The route is yours.

quests.title: Bodyweight set
quests.description: Three rounds of something simple: squats, push-ups, lunges. Pick your own numbers.

quests.title: Long patrol
quests.description: Thirty minutes on foot. Podcasts, music or silence are all approved equipment.

quests.title: Step goal
quests.description: Hit whatever daily step target you have set for yourself. Honor system, as always.

quests.title: Perimeter run
quests.description: Twenty minutes of running, cycling or anything that gets you out of breath.

quests.title: Training session
quests.description: A proper forty-minute workout, at home or at a gym. Water bottle recommended.

quests.title: Join a session
quests.description: Attend a class, a team practice or a group sport. Showing up is the whole quest.

quests.title: Threshold check
quests.description: Stand outside the door, on the balcony or at an open window for five minutes of daylight. Breathe. Report back.

quests.title: Daylight walk
quests.description: Ten minutes outside while the sun is up. Around the block is plenty.

quests.title: Fresh air post
quests.description: Open a window or door wide and spend ten minutes beside it. Wren accepts this as a scouting position.

quests.title: Errand on foot
quests.description: Do one real errand without a car: post office, shop, pharmacy, a return.

quests.title: Bench duty
quests.description: Sit in a park, square or garden for twenty minutes. Phones allowed, but look up occasionally.

quests.title: Morning light
quests.description: Be outdoors at any point before ten in the morning, even for a minute.

quests.title: Lunch under the sky
quests.description: Eat one meal or snack outdoors today.

quests.title: An hour out
quests.description: Sixty minutes outdoors in total today. Split it however you like.

quests.title: Green patrol
quests.description: Thirty minutes somewhere with trees, water or grass.

quests.title: Scout a new street
quests.description: Walk somewhere you have never been, even one street over. Wren wants the map updated.

quests.title: Make the bed
quests.description: Pull the covers straight. Thirty seconds that make the room look lived in on purpose.

quests.title: Take out the trash
quests.description: Bins and recycling out. Ondra will note the time on the clipboard.

quests.title: Clear the sink
quests.description: Every dish washed or in the machine. The counter does not count as storage.

quests.title: One clear surface
quests.description: Pick a table, desk or counter and clear it completely.

quests.title: Ten-minute tidy
quests.description: Set the timer, tidy anything until it rings, then stop. Stopping is part of the quest.

quests.title: Laundry cycle
quests.description: Wash one load and put it away. Folding is encouraged, not enforced.

quests.title: Floor sweep
quests.description: Vacuum or sweep at least one room.

quests.title: Bathroom detail
quests.description: Sink, mirror, toilet. The Haven's water pressure improves mysteriously afterwards.

quests.title: Ten things out
quests.description: Ten items leave the home: donated, recycled, binned or returned to their owner.

quests.title: Deep clean
quests.description: Forty-five minutes on one room, properly. Corners included.

quests.title: Say hello
quests.description: Greet a neighbour, a cashier, a bus driver. Two words, counted in full.

quests.title: Send a message
quests.description: Write to someone you like. It does not need a reason.

quests.title: Specific thanks
quests.description: Thank someone for one specific thing they did. Tobi says vague thanks is just weather.

quests.title: Clear the inbox
quests.description: Reply to three messages that have been waiting on you.

quests.title: Ten-minute call
quests.description: Voice or video, ten minutes, with anyone you choose.

quests.title: Call home
quests.description: Fifteen minutes with a family member or someone who counts as one.

quests.title: Make a plan
quests.description: Agree a day and time to see someone this week. Put it somewhere you will see it.

quests.title: Lend a hand
quests.description: Help someone with one small thing: carry, fix, listen, explain.

quests.title: Meet in person
quests.description: Spend time with someone face to face. A coffee counts; so does a walk.

quests.title: Join the crowd
quests.description: Attend a group activity: a club, class, game night, volunteering shift.

quests.title: Three lines for tomorrow
quests.description: Write down the three things that matter tomorrow. Imre files it under strategy.

quests.title: Five-minute review
quests.description: Reread yesterday's notes or the last thing you studied.

quests.title: Five lines of notes
quests.description: Learn something and write five lines about it, by hand or typed.

quests.title: Ten pages, or ten minutes
quests.description: Read something that is not a feed. Fiction counts.

quests.title: Focus block
quests.description: Twenty-five minutes on one task with notifications off.

quests.title: One lesson
quests.description: Complete one unit of a course, language app or tutorial.

quests.title: Practice session
quests.description: Twenty minutes practising a skill: instrument, drawing, code, a language.

quests.title: Explain it back
quests.description: Explain something you learned this week to a person, a pet or an empty chair.

quests.title: Deep work
quests.description: Fifty uninterrupted minutes on the hard thing.

quests.title: Two blocks
quests.description: Two separate focus blocks today, with a real break in between.

quests.title: Prepare the watchpost
quests.description: Make the bedroom dark, cool and tidy before you need it.

quests.title: Nap discipline
quests.description: No naps after four in the afternoon. Lunel says the night needs you tired.

quests.title: Wind-down
quests.description: Ten quiet minutes before bed: stretch, read, breathe, stare at the ceiling.

quests.title: Screens down
quests.description: No screens for the last thirty minutes before lights-out.

quests.title: Lights-out on time
quests.description: In bed with the lights off by the hour you set in Settings.

quests.title: Up on time
quests.description: Out of bed by the wake hour you set in Settings. Snooze is a monster.

quests.title: Caffeine curfew
quests.description: No caffeine after two in the afternoon.

quests.title: Seven hours
quests.description: Seven or more hours in bed last night. Report on waking.

quests.title: Both anchors
quests.description: Lights-out on time and up on time, same night. The Nightwatch salutes.

quests.title: Something green
quests.description: A vegetable or a fruit with at least one meal.

quests.title: Breakfast
quests.description: Eat something within two hours of getting up.

quests.title: Meal at the table
quests.description: One meal sitting down, no screen. Basil calls this dignity.

quests.title: Six glasses
quests.description: Six glasses of water across the day. Tap the counter each time.

quests.title: Cook one meal
quests.description: Make a meal from ingredients. Toast with toppings is a legitimate meal.

quests.title: Eight glasses
quests.description: Eight glasses of water today.

quests.title: Resupply run
quests.description: Do a grocery shop with at least one fresh thing in the basket.

quests.title: Three meals
quests.description: Breakfast, lunch, dinner. Size does not matter; rhythm does.

quests.title: Batch cook
quests.description: Cook enough for at least two days. Future you is a citizen too.

quests.title: New recipe
quests.description: Cook something you have never made before. Results may vary; XP will not.

quests.title: Wash your face
quests.description: Morning or night, warm water, done.

quests.title: Fresh clothes
quests.description: Change into clean clothes today, even if nobody will see them.

quests.title: Floss
quests.description: Once. Marisol knows it is boring; she is counting anyway.

quests.title: Brush twice
quests.description: Morning and night. Tap the counter after each.

quests.title: Shower or bath
quests.description: Hot water, soap, the full ceremony.

quests.title: Grooming
quests.description: Hair, beard, brows, whatever you maintain. Ten minutes in front of the mirror.

quests.title: Hands and nails
quests.description: Trim, file, moisturise. The small stuff.

quests.title: Fresh sheets
quests.description: Change the bedding. Tonight's sleep quest thanks you in advance.

quests.title: Self-care hour
quests.description: A full hour on yourself: long bath, skincare, music, no obligations.

quests.title: Health appointment
quests.description: Book or attend a doctor, dentist, optician or therapist appointment.
